comment: maxDuration 60 (the Hobby ceiling), raised from 30 for the cloud OCR route. A vision read of one screenshot at detail:high was measured at 24.9s, which left no headroom at all. This is a CEILING, not a delay: every other route still returns in milliseconds. OCR_TIMEOUT_MS defaults to 45000 so the fetch aborts cleanly INSIDE this window — set the two equal and the socket dies at the same instant the platform gives up, turning a clean 504 into an opaque error. No `regions` key on purpose: the default iad1 is what lets the API call OpenAI from the US, which is why Damascus needs no VPN.
